page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Marginal notes in the left margin: "Mors æstate & hieme contingens..." beside the paragraph starting "aphor.", and "NB." beside the paragraph starting "Verum locus". Printed page number at the top left, running head at the top centre.

main_text.p: vehementem, vel heterogeneum € oppositum, ut siestas mutetur in frigiditatem € humiditatem, lædentem € contra communem naturæ cursum.

Mors æ-state & hieme contin-gens à cœlo ma-gis quàm à causa inferiori depédet.aphor. Si magna fuerint, subita & vehementer et pariunt morbos, € quando mortem. subita enim mutatione qualitatum alterarum, vehementer ter impertinentium forsan occurrentium, ut cali-ditatis in æstate, frigiditatis in hieme, mortem in-firmis aliquando accidere, & etiam nunc accidere posse patet, nam mortem, quæ infirmis æstate continget & hieme, potissimum à virtute cœlesti agentes, te naturalem aeris statum supra modum € subito immutante dependere animadversum est, in vere vero € autumno magis à causa inferiori € tempore restri.

Inter causas inferiores, à quibus aer promtiùs corrumpi potest, sunt vapores, halitusque malignì terra quibusdam cauernis et aperturis expirantes, exhalantes, tum etiam sœda hominum € animalium strages, aquarum stagnantium € putri-darum corruptela, tetra, € contagiosa aliaruni rerum putrefactium, ut ex peco: sumus stabulis € cloacis, tum animalibus etiam quibus-dam venenosis.

Verum locus siue regio, regionis altitudo € bu-militas montium marium, vicinitas, ipsiusq; regio-nis terra hic perpendenda est. page.notes: Printed text is very dense and faint; many words are read from context and marked [?]. The symbol "€" before "oppositum" and in similar places is an uncertain abbreviation or ornament. The Latin "eri-tis" and "præci-" lines and the sentence "Non enim in ö-nt" are uncertain. Greek and Hebrew: none. Running head reads "De Vita" in large capitals on the scan, but letters are unclear.
